firmware.notes: Encrypted link with the board's PIN, in-app updates with automatic rollback, ADC offset calibration at every run.
Safe mode after repeated crashes; evenly spaced sampling by default (25 % less noise); fixed: CA with bursts ran 4 % fast.

app.notes: Permanent app identity and release signing. If an older MSTAT app (1.7.1 or earlier) is installed: install this one, check it connects, then uninstall the old one. Exports in Download/MSTAT and Bluetooth pairings are kept.

firmware.notes: 1.17.0 beta: a run survives a dropped Bluetooth link (journal + resume); health record; SWV clip flags (1.16.0).

app.notes: Heartbeat carries the fitted gain resistor (dashboard shows hardware and current range); heartbeat at sign-in and on Send now.
